question: top 5 customers
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_order_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: What are the email addresses for the customers with IDs 3, 1, 2, 23, and 60?
sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE id IN (3, 1, 2, 23, 60);

question: top 5 products which are most returnable ?
sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, COUNT(r.id) AS return_count
FROM returns r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY return_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average order value for each of the top 5 most returnable products (IDs 1, 2, 14, 44, and 33)?
sql:
SELECT oi.product_id,
       AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order_value
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT product_id, order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IN (1, 2, 14, 44, 33)
) oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY oi.product_id
ORDER BY oi.product_id;

question: give top 5 customers by average order value and then tell top 5 products with most revenue and then tell the average market expense from all the categores like social etc
sql:
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.name,
    AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order_value
FROM
    customers c
JOIN
    orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY
    c.id,
    c.name
ORDER BY
    average_order_value DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: give top 5 customers by average order value and then tell top 5 products with most revenue and then tell the average market expense from all the categores like social etc
sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
